### 2026-11-01: did the cad

**5.32h**

did the cad

when i was exporting the pcb from kicad to onshape it should be like whole of one part right but it was

so it like composite part i had to it manually select every part then it became like one part

then used transform tool to place wherever i wanted

then started designing in cad

eyes nose ears are like design part which took so less time

it was my first time making a pcb enclosure yeah  thats y i was kinda struggling now it feels easy i dont know why took that much time

the mounting holes was the struggle cause when i was doing circle sketch it was showing as a sketch in one circle not in others i  did not realise it was already extrude i should remove it then it is simple after some time i realised i extrude them thats y it was like that

it was designed the bottom case top case the cute things as well which i wanted to add

one thing  i still need to fix is i cutted display and push buttons it should apply only for top layer not for bottom but it is applying for both cases just need to figure out that one thing and i am done with cad
